failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query at hop 2: 'Who composed the opera "I puritani" and what was their nationality?' - This is a natural-language yes/no question format rather than entity-focused query terms.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query at hop 2 asks 'Who composed the opera "I puritani" and what was their nationality?' when hop 1 passages already answered this (passage [1]: 'Vincenzo Bellini... I puritani'). Query at hop 3 'Mikhail Glinka, Vincenzo Bellini, I puritani' re-targets entities already covered in hops 1-2, retrieving duplicate documents (e.g., 'Marino Faliero (opera)' and 'I puritani' article appear in multiple hops).

failure_modes.name: Solver_Passage_Content_Misreading
failure_modes.evidence: In the solver's reasoning after hop 2, it states: 'The context attribution to passage [7] is incorrect—that passage discusses English composer John Hardy, not Glinka.' However, the actual hop 1 retrieval included passage [7] 'Mikhail Glinka | Mikhail Ivanovich Glinka... was the first Russian composer' - the solver misread which passage [7] was being referenced, confusing hop 1 passage [7] (Glinka) with hop 2 passage [7] (John Hardy).
